name: Egress
source:
A man stands in front of a door. His heart racing 100 miles a minute, drowning in sweat and fear. With a gun and his thoughts alone, he stands with his back against the wall...

Waiting. 

[From [url=https://velvetique.itch.io/egress]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个男人站在门前。他的心跳每分钟一百英里，淹没在汗水和恐惧之中。他拿着枪，独自思考，背靠墙站着……

等待。

[来自[url=https://velvetique.itch.io/egress]Itch.io[/url]]
